bo_join.said:
You're in Lab, as Bo.
Lab's folder is /tmp/sh-w-after/bo/svrngs/Lab: what anyone in Lab puts there reaches this computer, and what you put there reaches theirs.

llama-server.said:
Lent llama-server (port 18089) to everyone in your groups, up to 4 people at once.
They cannot open /slots, /v1/stream, /v1/streams, /v1/chat/completions/control, /lora-adapters, /metrics, /tools, /cors-proxy, /models: svrngs keeps these back whenever a llama-server is lent, since they show one person's use of it to the others or change it for everyone.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare llama-server` stops lending it.
If llama-server takes a password on each request, paste what it takes in its Authorization header, then press Enter (Enter alone for none):

night.said:
Lent night (port 18091) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 18091 --limit <number>`.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare night` stops lending it.
If night takes a password on each request, paste what it takes in its Authorization header, then press Enter (Enter alone for none):

taste.said:
Lent taste (port 18092) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 18092 --limit <number>`.
An app uses it only once the person it acts for says yes to: "the films you have marked".
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare taste` stops lending it.
If taste takes a password on each request, paste what it takes in its Authorization header, then press Enter (Enter alone for none):
